h1: Product Photo and Video Guides for Online Sellers
lead: These product photo and video guides are short, practical reads for Shopify, Amazon, and Etsy sellers. Each guide covers one task you can finish in an afternoon, from your first product photo to your first ad.
card: Short how-to guides for sellers, from first photo to first ad.

how to make product video ads
intro: These guides are for sellers who handle their own photos and ads. You won't need a studio or a design background. Each one walks through a single job with plain steps and real product examples: shooting a clear photo on your phone, getting a white background main image ready for Amazon, planning a short TikTok ad, choosing the right shape for each platform, and comparing a few ad versions without guessing. Read them in any order, and keep the checklists handy for your next listing or campaign.

faq.q: Do I need a camera or a studio to follow these guides?
faq.a: No. Every guide assumes you have a phone, a window with daylight, and a plain surface. If you own more gear, the same steps still apply.

faq.q: Which guide should I read first?
faq.a: Start with the product photo guide. The photo you shoot is the starting point for every image and video you make, so getting it right saves time on everything after.

faq.q: How do I choose the right product photo guide?
faq.a: Start with product-photo tips for the source image, then use the platform guide for the destination. The steps are upload, describe, generate, and review.

faq.q: Do these guides state platform requirements?
faq.a: The platform guides link to current official requirements. Check the linked TikTok, Meta, Amazon, Shopify, or Google page on the day you publish because specs can change.
